subtitle: Lesson 5 · Backup Fundamentals, Deep Dive

code:
RESTORE VERIFYONLY
FROM DISK = N'D:\Backup\Sales_Full.bak'
WITH CHECKSUM;

-- checks: backup set complete, header valid,
--         page checksums intact (if WITH CHECKSUM at backup time)
-- does NOT: actually restore or recover a database
caption: A backup can pass this cleanly and still surprise you during a real restore.

eyebrow: Catching corruption during the backup itself
code:
BACKUP DATABASE Sales
TO DISK = N'D:\Backup\Sales_Full.bak'
WITH CHECKSUM, STATS = 10;

-- corrupt page found -> backup stops (default: STOP_ON_ERROR)
-- CONTINUE_AFTER_ERROR finishes anyway -- treat result as suspect
caption: CHECKSUM validates pages as they're read, before they're silently backed up.
